column1: Welcome to PulseMap, your shared workspace for field operations.
Create a workspace before inviting the rest of the crew.
Each workspace stores routes, checkpoints, and Beacon history.
If a Beacon stops moving, PulseMap marks it as idle.
You can rename the Beacon from the workspace overview.
Trail Mode records every checkpoint while you walk the route.
Turn it off before you leave the marked area.
When Trail Mode is paused, new checkpoints are saved as drafts.
The Sync Ledger shows which drafts were uploaded.
If the ledger is empty, check that the Beacon is online.
Share the workspace link with a supervisor after the route is complete.
They can review the Sync Ledger without changing checkpoints.
If a checkpoint looks wrong, open it and compare it with the Beacon history.
Keep the same Beacon name in every report.
Archive the workspace only after all supervisors confirm the route.
